where-to-stay.title: Where to stay in Trabzon: a quiet base between the airport and Meydan
where-to-stay.description: Stay near Forum Trabzon with dolmuş outside the hotel, free parking and practical access to Meydan, the airport, KTÜ and Farabi from Pelit Park.
where-to-stay.intro: A stay in Trabzon does not have to mean sleeping beside the busiest streets of Meydan. Pelit Park Hotel offers a quieter, family-run base in the Forum and university area, with public transport outside and convenient access to the centre. Here is how that location works in everyday use.
sections: Meydan for the evening, a quieter neighbourhood for the night

Meydan suits visitors who want to step straight into the central streets. It also brings traffic, evening noise and the challenge of finding somewhere to park. Our guests often prefer to visit the centre and return to a calmer neighbourhood. Cleanliness, comfortable new beds and a welcoming family atmosphere are the qualities they most often mention to our team.

Our published Google guest rating is 4.9/5. Alongside the score, the qualities guests most often discuss with our team are cleanliness, rest and the family atmosphere.
Four useful driving times

From Pelit Park, management's usual driving estimates are about 10 minutes to Meydan, 5 minutes to Trabzon Airport, 2 minutes to Forum Trabzon and 3 minutes to the bus terminal. These are approximate journey times and increase with traffic. The location is especially practical when your stay combines arrival or departure, shopping and time in the city rather than a single destination.
Getting into town without a car

Dolmuş minibuses pass directly in front of the hotel. For the centre, take one displaying Meydan; from Meydan, the return service to look for is TRT Bostancı. For the Ganita waterfront, take the Moloz direction. These names are useful to keep on your phone in Turkish. Reception can also call a taxi when you have luggage or prefer a direct ride.
What is within walking distance

Forum Trabzon is approximately 15 minutes away on foot. The outward walk is comfortable, while the uphill return takes more effort, particularly with shopping bags or a pushchair. A ŞOK market is around a two-minute walk away. For visitors to KTÜ or relatives at Farabi, the neighbourhood also provides an ordinary hotel base close to the university and hospital area.
checklist: Meydan: about 10 minutes by car, depending on traffic.
Dolmuş destination signs: Meydan, TRT Bostancı and Moloz.
Forum: about 15 minutes on foot; uphill on the way back.
Free hotel parking and 24-hour reception.
faq: Is Pelit Park actually on Meydan?
No. It is in a quieter part of Trabzon around the Forum and university area, approximately 10 minutes from Meydan by car in usual conditions.
Can I stay here without hiring a car?
Yes. Dolmuş passes the hotel for trips toward Meydan and Moloz, Forum is walkable, and reception can call a taxi.

hotel-prices.title: Trabzon hotel costs: rooms, breakfast and the extras families pay
hotel-prices.description: Understand Pelit Park's room-only and breakfast rates, free parking, €10 daily extra beds and €5 baby cots, with a worked three-night family example.
hotel-prices.intro: A useful hotel budget starts with real inclusions and known extras. At Pelit Park, parking is free, breakfast can be included or excluded from the room rate, and the charges for an additional bed or baby cot are clear. This makes it easier to budget beyond the first price in a search result.
sections: What the room price buys

Standard Double has a double bed; Twin has two separate single beds; Deluxe Double is the sea-view double category. The family suite is a separate two-bedroom option. All rooms have new comfortable beds, a 50-inch Smart TV and a private bathroom. An economy room and a sea-view room represent different stays, so a low headline price does not describe every room in the hotel.
Known extras, with a three-night example

An extra bed suitable for an adult costs €10 per day. A baby cot costs €5 per day. Over three charged days, one extra bed adds €30 to the room total, while one cot adds €15. These are separate examples: they do not establish that both fit into the same room. Regular rooms accommodate two guests, or three with the appropriate additional sleeping arrangement.
Breakfast and parking in your budget

The Turkish open buffet runs from 08:00 to 11:00 in the breakfast room reached using the R lift button. It includes cold dishes, hot selections, tea and coffee, with views of the sea and Boztepe. Some rates include breakfast and some are room-only; use the inclusion shown on your selected offer. Hotel parking has no extra charge, which is useful for a driving holiday.
Choosing value instead of the smallest room price

Direct contact helps our team match the room to your group: separate beds, a Deluxe sea view or the family suite can matter more than the cheapest category. Direct reservations also allow a conversation about flexibility, with the agreed terms recorded in the booking. Nightly room prices vary by date and availability; the booking system gives the current room total rather than a permanent price in this guide.
checklist: Adult extra bed: €10 per day.
Baby cot: €5 per day.
Hotel parking: complimentary.
Breakfast: included only in the selected breakfast-inclusive rate.
faq: What does an extra bed cost for three days?
€30 for one extra bed at €10 per day, in addition to the booked room price.
Does direct booking automatically mean a lower price?
Not always. Its practical benefit is personal help choosing a suitable room and discussing the arrangements available for your stay.

family-stays.title: Family rooms in Trabzon: a two-bedroom suite or a room for three
family-stays.description: Pelit Park's family suite has a double room, twin room, two bathrooms and one sea-view bedroom. Read the capacity, extra-bed fees and fifth-floor access.
family-stays.intro: Families choose Pelit Park for its quiet atmosphere, cleanliness and personal welcome. The right sleeping arrangement is just as important. A couple with one child has different needs from a family of five, so here are the actual room layouts and the access details that matter.
sections: A regular room for two or three guests

Our regular rooms are arranged for two guests. An extra bed can accommodate a third person and is suitable for an adult; it costs €10 per day. A baby cot costs €5 per day. Standard and Deluxe Double rooms have a double bed, while Twin rooms have two separate beds. All have new comfortable beds and a 50-inch Smart TV for time spent resting between outings.
Inside the two-bedroom family suite

The family suite consists of two bedrooms connected by their own private corridor. One bedroom has a double bed and the other has two separate single beds. Each bedroom has its own bathroom, making two bathrooms in total. The suite accommodates four guests, or five with an additional bed. A panoramic sea view is available from one bedroom, not both.
The fifth floor, stairs and the attic ceiling

The suite is on the fifth floor. The lift reaches the fourth floor, and the final floor is reached by stairs. It also has a sloping attic ceiling, known in Turkish as a çatı ceiling. These are part of the room's layout, alongside its impressive view. Guests who need a step-free route should choose a different arrangement with the hotel; the suite is not accessible solely by lift.
An easier family morning

Breakfast is a Turkish open buffet from 08:00 to 11:00, with cheeses, olives, honey, pastries and changing hot dishes. Breakfast-inclusive and room-only rates are both available. If a room is ready, arrival from 09:00 can be accommodated free of charge; otherwise reception can keep your bags. Forum is about 15 minutes away on foot, with a more demanding uphill walk back.
checklist: Suite: four guests, or five with one extra bed.
Two bedrooms, a private corridor and two bathrooms.
Panoramic sea view from one bedroom.
Fifth floor: lift to floor four, then stairs; sloping ceiling.
faq: Can five adults use the family suite?
The suite can accommodate five guests with one additional adult-suitable bed, charged at €10 per day.
Does the lift reach the family suite?
No. It reaches floor four; the suite is on floor five and requires the final stairs.

parking.title: A Trabzon hotel with free parking: driving from Pelit Park
parking.description: Free parking at Pelit Park, reception-assisted overflow, short drives to the airport and Forum, and a dolmuş alternative for busy Meydan visits.
parking.intro: Having a car in Trabzon is convenient, but parking in the busiest central streets can become the least relaxing part of the day. Pelit Park provides complimentary parking and a quieter base, so you can choose when to drive and when to leave the car behind.
sections: How our parking works

Hotel guests use the parking area free of charge. When it fills up, reception can coordinate an arrangement in the access lane, with the vehicle key left at reception so cars can be moved when needed. Speak to the team on arrival for this arrangement. It is a practical overflow solution, rather than an individually reserved space or an unlimited parking promise.
Short drives for arrival, shopping and departure

Our usual estimates are approximately 5 minutes by car to Trabzon Airport, 3 minutes to the bus terminal and 2 minutes to Forum Trabzon. Meydan is approximately 10 minutes away. Traffic changes these times, so they describe the location rather than a guaranteed journey. The combination is useful when a rental car is part of your holiday.
Leave the car for a Meydan evening

A central outing does not require taking the car into Meydan's traffic and finding another parking space. Dolmuş passes the hotel: take the Meydan direction into town and TRT Bostancı for the return. The Moloz direction is useful for the Ganita waterfront. Reception can call a taxi if you prefer to return directly after dinner.
Arriving before the room is ready

Standard check-in begins at 14:00, but free early check-in is possible from 09:00 when a room is available. If it is not ready, leave your bags with reception and start the day without carrying them. Reception operates around the clock, so a late arrival has someone to welcome you. Midnight arrival still needs the appropriate night's room reservation.
checklist: Parking carries no additional hotel charge.
Reception coordinates overflow and keeps the vehicle key.
Meydan-bound dolmuş passes directly outside.
Check-in 14:00; free early access from 09:00 when available.
faq: What happens when the main parking area is full?
Reception can arrange parking in the access lane and will need the vehicle key to coordinate moving cars.
Can we visit the centre while leaving the car at the hotel?
Yes. Use the Meydan dolmuş from outside the hotel; for the return, look for TRT Bostancı.

sea-view-rooms.title: Sea-view rooms in Trabzon: Deluxe Double and the family suite
sea-view-rooms.description: Choose between Pelit Park's Deluxe Double and family suite: one panoramic suite bedroom, two bathrooms, attic stairs and a breakfast room with sea views.
sea-view-rooms.intro: A sea view is worth describing precisely. At Pelit Park, couples can choose the Deluxe Double category, while a larger family can stay in the two-bedroom suite. These options have different layouts and access, and the suite's view belongs to one of its two bedrooms.
sections: Deluxe Double for a couple

The Deluxe Double category combines a double bed with a sea view. It suits two guests who want the view without choosing a two-bedroom family arrangement. New comfortable beds and a 50-inch Smart TV are part of the room amenities. Standard Double and Twin describe other room choices; neither category carries a general sea-view promise.
A panoramic bedroom in the family suite

The suite has one double bedroom and one bedroom with two single beds, connected by a private corridor. Each has its own bathroom. One bedroom offers the panoramic sea view; the other does not have that same outlook. Four people can stay in the suite, or five with an extra bed charged at €10 per day.
The view comes with an attic layout

The family suite is on floor five under a sloping attic ceiling. The lift stops at floor four, so the final floor requires stairs. That access detail belongs in the room choice as much as the photograph of the sea. A guest unable to use stairs needs another arrangement; this suite does not offer a completely step-free route.
Sea and Boztepe views over breakfast

The view is not limited to sleeping rooms. The breakfast room, reached with the lift's R button, looks toward the sea and Boztepe. The Turkish buffet is served from 08:00 to 11:00, with cheeses, olives, jams, honey, hot selections, tea and coffee. Breakfast is available through breakfast-inclusive rates; room-only bookings are also offered.
checklist: Deluxe Double is a sea-view double category.
Only one of the suite's two bedrooms has the panoramic view.
Suite access includes stairs and a sloping attic ceiling.
The breakfast room overlooks the sea and Boztepe.
faq: Do both family-suite bedrooms face the sea?
No. The panoramic sea view is in one bedroom only.
Does a sea-view room necessarily have a balcony?
A balcony is a separate feature and is not promised for every room in these categories.

airport-arrival.title: Trabzon Airport arrival: a nearby hotel with free early check-in
airport-arrival.description: Pelit Park is about five minutes from Trabzon Airport by car in usual conditions, with 24-hour reception, luggage storage and free early access from 09:00 if ready.
airport-arrival.intro: After a flight, the useful questions are simple: how far is the hotel, will someone welcome you, and what happens if you arrive early? Pelit Park is approximately five minutes from Trabzon Airport by car in usual conditions, and reception is staffed 24 hours.
sections: The short airport-to-hotel journey

The airport is one of the reasons guests choose this part of Trabzon. Management's approximate driving estimate is five minutes, depending on traffic. Reception can call a taxi for your departure and help you communicate your destination. This is taxi assistance; a private airport transfer is not included automatically with the room. The airport's official transport page is linked below.
Free early check-in from 09:00 when available

Normal check-in is 14:00. If a room is available and ready, we offer early check-in from 09:00 without an extra fee. When a room is not yet ready, reception can keep your luggage while you go out. This gives you an option for the morning without treating early room access as guaranteed.
Late flights and the first night's reservation

Reception works around the clock, with Turkish, English and Arabic communication available within the team. Translation tools help with other languages. A very late flight does not mean the hotel closes, but the room must be booked for the night you intend to use. Arrival shortly after midnight is different from the normal afternoon check-in for that calendar date.
A gentle first morning and the return flight

The Turkish breakfast buffet runs from 08:00 to 11:00 in the room marked R in the lift, with sea and Boztepe views. Breakfast inclusion follows the booked rate. If you arrive before your room is ready, nearby markets or a Forum visit can fill the time. Checkout is at 12:00; allow airport preparation time in addition to the short road journey.
checklist: Airport: approximately five minutes by car, traffic-dependent.
Reception is open 24 hours.
Free early check-in from 09:00, subject to a ready room.
Normal check-in 14:00; checkout 12:00.
faq: Do I pay extra for check-in at 09:00?
No, when a room is available and ready. Early access is offered free of charge from 09:00.
What if my room is not ready when I arrive?
Reception can keep your bags so you can go out while the room is being prepared.

forum-shopping.title: Near Forum Trabzon: walking, shopping and everyday essentials
forum-shopping.description: Forum is about 15 minutes on foot from Pelit Park, with an uphill return. Find nearby markets, a local döner option and the official duty-pharmacy list.
forum-shopping.intro: Forum Trabzon is an easy outing from Pelit Park, but a useful neighbourhood guide should also explain the walk back and where to find everyday essentials. Here are the details our reception team gives guests who want to shop, pick up groceries or eat nearby.
sections: The Forum walk, including the return

The walk from the hotel to Forum Trabzon takes approximately 15 minutes. The outward journey is comfortable; coming back involves an uphill stretch and can feel harder with bags or children. You can walk down and use a taxi for the return if that suits your group. By car, management estimates around two minutes in usual traffic conditions.
Groceries close to the hotel

There are three markets in the surrounding area. ŞOK is about a two-minute walk from the hotel, with usual hours reported by our team as 09:00–21:00. Neşe is the local option we point guests toward later in the evening and usually remains open until midnight. Holiday or branch hours may differ, but these names give you a useful starting point without a trip to the centre.
A nearby meal or dinner on the seafront

For a convenient nearby döner, our team recommends Maydonoz Döner. If you combine shopping with an evening in the centre, our Katık recommendation refers specifically to its Meydan branch. For seafood beside the water, we recommend Ganita. These are the reception team's local suggestions, not meal services included in your hotel reservation.
Nearby pharmacies and out-of-hours help

İlknur Eczanesi, Alper Eczanesi and Yağız Eczanesi are nearby pharmacies identified by our team. For a pharmacy outside normal opening hours, use the Trabzon Chamber of Pharmacists' current Ortahisar duty list linked below. It shows the pharmacies on duty for the relevant date, rather than relying on an old article to name a permanently open shop.
checklist: Forum: about 15 minutes walking, with an uphill return.
ŞOK: approximately two minutes on foot.
Neşe is the team's usual late-evening market suggestion.
An official Ortahisar duty-pharmacy link appears below.
faq: Is walking back from Forum as easy as walking there?
The return is uphill and more demanding, especially with shopping or a pushchair; a taxi is another option.
Where can I find a pharmacy at night?
Use the official Ortahisar duty-pharmacy list linked in this guide for that day's pharmacy and contact details.

first-visit.title: Three days in Trabzon: Meydan, Ganita and a relaxed local stay
first-visit.description: A practical three-day city plan from Pelit Park: Turkish breakfast, Meydan and Ganita by dolmuş, local food, Forum shopping and a gentle departure day.
first-visit.intro: For a first short stay, three manageable days can be more enjoyable than a long list of distant attractions. This plan uses Pelit Park as a base for the city, waterfront and Forum area, leaving time for meals and rest. It can be rearranged around your flight.
sections: Day one: settle in and explore the neighbourhood

Leave luggage at reception if the room is not ready; free early room access starts at 09:00 when available. For essentials, ŞOK is approximately two minutes away on foot. Forum is about a 15-minute walk, with an uphill return. A nearby Maydonoz Döner meal gives you a simple first-day option without committing to another trip across the city.
Day two: breakfast, Meydan and the waterfront

Start with the 08:00–11:00 Turkish buffet if your rate includes breakfast. Then take a dolmuş marked Meydan from outside the hotel for time in the centre. Our team's döner recommendation there is Katık's Meydan branch. Ganita is the seafront option for a stroll and seafood; from the hotel, Moloz is the dolmuş direction used for that waterfront outing.

Usual cold choices include several cheeses, olives, jams, honey and labneh. Hot selections include fries, börek, mini pizzas, pastries and omelette, alongside tea and coffee; some dishes change from day to day.
Choose a comfortable return, not a rushed evening

For the return from Meydan, look for TRT Bostancı. Keep that name in Turkish on your phone, or ask reception to call a taxi when a direct trip suits you better. A quieter evening back at the hotel leaves time to rest on the new comfortable beds. Rooms also have a 50-inch Smart TV for a break between outings.
Day three: views over breakfast and departure

The breakfast room has views of Boztepe and the sea and is reached with the R lift button. Keep the last morning light if you have a flight: checkout is 12:00, and the drive to Trabzon Airport is approximately five minutes in usual conditions. That road estimate does not include airport formalities. If you have more time, the official Trabzon tourism guide below offers ideas for extending the trip.
checklist: Day one: neighbourhood essentials and Forum.
Day two: Meydan, local döner and Ganita.
Return from Meydan: TRT Bostancı dolmuş.
Day three: breakfast views and a manageable departure.
faq: Do I need a rental car for this city plan?
No. It uses walkable neighbourhood stops, dolmuş routes and optional taxis.
Does this itinerary include distant day trips?
No. It is a relaxed introduction to the city and waterfront, leaving longer excursions for extra days.

direct-booking.title: Booking Pelit Park directly: the right room and a more personal stay
direct-booking.description: Direct booking at Pelit Park helps you choose beyond the economy room, discuss flexible arrangements and plan beds, breakfast and arrival with the team.
direct-booking.intro: A direct reservation is useful because you can describe the stay you actually want. Many online searches start with the economy category, while a sea view, separate beds or two bedrooms may suit your trip better. Our team can explain those differences before you choose.
sections: Start with the room that fits your group

A couple seeking a sea view can consider Deluxe Double; two friends may prefer Twin; four or five relatives may need the family suite. The suite has two bedrooms and two bathrooms, with a panoramic view from one bedroom. Its fifth-floor position also means stairs after the lift's fourth-floor stop and a sloping ceiling. Direct conversation brings these useful details into the decision.
More room for a personal conversation

Booking directly lets you discuss dates, arrival and the room choices available with the people who will welcome you. Our team aims to offer practical flexibility where it can. The benefit is an agreed arrangement for your booking, rather than an automatic room upgrade, unconditional date changes or a promise to beat every platform price.
Put the real extras into the plan

An adult-suitable extra bed costs €10 per day and a baby cot €5 per day. Breakfast-inclusive and room-only rates are both available, and parking is complimentary. Mention any particular meal request in advance: the team will assess whether it can prepare it. This personal approach reflects a family-run hotel, while keeping special requests realistic.
Arrange an arrival that works for you

Reception operates 24 hours, with Turkish, English and Arabic spoken within the team and translation tools for other languages. Normal check-in is 14:00; from 09:00, a ready room can be provided early free of charge. Otherwise reception can hold your luggage. Use the official booking or WhatsApp buttons below to discuss the room and receive the agreed reservation details.
checklist: Personal help choosing the actual room category.
Flexibility discussed for your own reservation.
Extra bed €10/day; baby cot €5/day.
Free early access from 09:00 when the room is ready.
faq: Will booking directly guarantee a free upgrade?
No. The team helps you choose from available room options and can discuss suitable arrangements; a better room is not automatically included.
Can I discuss a special meal before arrival?
Yes. Send the request to the hotel, and the team will let you know whether it can accommodate it.

work-and-visits.title: Staying near KTÜ and Farabi: a quiet Trabzon base for your visit
work-and-visits.description: Pelit Park welcomes university applicants and Farabi visitors with a quiet atmosphere, Twin rooms, 24-hour reception, breakfast and nearby daily essentials.
work-and-visits.intro: A university application or a visit to a relative at Farabi can mean early starts, uncertain plans and time spent waiting. Our guests making these trips value a clean, quiet place to return to. Pelit Park provides ordinary hotel accommodation in the Forum, university and Farabi area, with practical help from reception.
sections: A room for the people making the trip

Twin rooms offer two separate single beds for companions, relatives or colleagues; Standard Double has a double bed. New comfortable beds, private bathrooms, Wi-Fi and 50-inch Smart TVs make the room a place to rest between appointments. The hotel hosts people visiting the university or hospital without presenting accommodation as a medical service or an institutional package.
A larger group and the suite's access

For four guests, the family suite provides a double bedroom, a twin bedroom and two bathrooms, connected by a private corridor. An extra bed brings capacity to five at €10 per day. One bedroom has a panoramic sea view. The suite is on floor five under a sloping ceiling; the lift stops at floor four, so this choice requires stairs for the final floor.
Breakfast and the day's practical needs

The buffet runs from 08:00 to 11:00, with Turkish cold dishes, hot selections, tea and coffee. Its room is marked R in the lift. There are breakfast-inclusive and room-only rates. ŞOK and other nearby markets cover everyday shopping, and İlknur, Alper and Yağız pharmacies are close by. For evenings or closures, the official Ortahisar duty-pharmacy list below identifies that day's duty pharmacies.
Arrival, communication and changing plans

The 24-hour reception can call taxis and welcome late arrivals. Turkish, English and Arabic are spoken within the team; translation tools help with other languages. Free early access from 09:00 is possible when a room is ready, and bags can stay at reception otherwise. Direct contact also makes it easier to discuss an extension or a change, with availability and agreed booking terms determining the arrangement.
checklist: Twin rooms have two separate beds.
Breakfast 08:00–11:00; reception open 24 hours.
Suite access requires stairs above floor four.
Official Farabi contact and duty-pharmacy links below.
faq: Is there a special hospital or university package?
This guide describes ordinary hotel accommodation for visitors. Appointments and university applications remain with the relevant institution.
Which room suits two companions needing separate beds?
Twin offers two single beds. Larger groups can consider the family suite, taking its final stairs and sloping ceiling into account.
